advisories.justification: vite: server.fs.deny bypass on Windows alternate paths. Dev-server-only issue, not present in production builds; the fix requires a Vite 5->6 major upgrade across every app in the monorepo (no 5.x backport exists). Tracked for that migration.

image-size JXL/HEIF parser DoS. A patch exists (>=2.0.3) but it is API-incompatible with this dependency chain: metro (React Native bundler) does `const getImageSize = require('image-size')` and calls the import directly, while image-size@2.x's CJS export is `{ imageSize, disableTypes, default, types }`, not a callable — confirmed by direct require() test, forcing the override throws `getImageSize is not a function` in metro's asset pipeline. Transitive dev/build dependency, not present in shipped runtime bundles and never fed attacker-controlled input. Real fix is a metro upgrade to a version that itself moves to image-size v2, not an override here.
image-size ICNS parser DoS — same root cause and same override incompatibility as 1239765 above, same package.

extract-zip unvalidated symlink path traversal (GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv); no patched version exists upstream. Transitive dev-only dependency of puppeteer-core; only extracts trusted Puppeteer/Chromium download artifacts, never user-supplied zips.

extract-zip arbitrary file write via symlink archive entries (GHSA-7pqw-9j4j-h8q3) — a separate advisory from 1139346 above, same package. No patched version exists upstream. Transitive dev-only dependency of puppeteer-core; only extracts trusted Puppeteer/Chromium download artifacts, never user-supplied zips.
